THE BAR IS A TWO-LEG GATE (DESIGN §3, amended 2026-07-30, issue #112).
Leg 1, VALIDITY: an exhaustive permutation of a PERMANOVA pseudo-F over
per-creator collocate profiles -- does the cross-side gap exceed the spread
among same-side creators? Leg 2, SPECIFICITY: the term's divergence must
fall in the top 5% of a frozen pool of up to 40 same-mass words. A claim
publishes as certified only when BOTH clear at the same frozen vintage.

Leg 2 exists because leg 1 alone is not specific: it passed roughly three
arbitrary same-frequency words in four, and passed all five
discourse-marker controls (whatever, literally, maybe, honestly,
basically). Composite false-positive rate, measured on 225
frequency-matched arbitrary words: 3.1%, against 74.7% for the validity
leg alone. Clearing BOTH legs is the published standard; a term clearing
only one publishes as provisional with the failing leg named, and low
cross-side distance publishes as a convergence finding rather than a null.
